title: Find the Maximum Length of Valid Subsequence I
summary: Given an integer array, find the maximum length of a subsequence where the alternating sum of consecutive elements is even.
statement: Given an integer array, find the maximum length of a subsequence where the alternating sum of consecutive elements is even.
constraints: nums is a nonempty integer array.
Choose a subsequence such that every adjacent chosen pair has the same sum parity.
Return the maximum length; valid sequences therefore either use one value parity throughout or alternate parities throughout.
hints: Constant adjacent-sum parity has only two cases: every chosen value has one parity, or chosen parities alternate.
Count all evens and odds, and greedily count the longest alternating-parity subsequence.
Same-parity pairs have even sums; different-parity pairs have odd sums, and greedily taking each next opposite parity maximizes an alternating subsequence.
editorial: Same-parity pairs have even sums; different-parity pairs have odd sums, and greedily taking each next opposite parity maximizes an alternating subsequence.

tests.explanation: All adjacent sums in the full alternating-parity sequence are odd, so its length is four.
The three odd values form a length-three subsequence whose adjacent sums are even.
